author: Haxorbacca
body:
My name ingame is: Haxorbacca
Reason I was banned:Kill Aura/Aimbot (Hack)
Why i want to be unbanned:I really want to be unbanned on this server because I really love this server and have been playing it ALOT My name was first kianc007 and changed it to Haxorbacca Because its my Youtube name and wanna make alot of videos on this server Why I like this server Is about Nexus And Nebula Its one of the BEST this mostly The only server I played on Before I was ban. When i discovered About Hacks I only wanted to have Fun, I dont want to use it for bad like Crashing the server or something This is the best If i get Back on the server I really ill maybe Try to Donate And Have Fun It Feels like I never played this for A year but it wasnt I really want to get back on this server And i hope to get back in.

The Person who banned me Was: _Sunny I really  dont know how she did know because nobody gave me a warning or something. So im really sry and wont do it again This was the only ban that i have so far. How long i Was banned is 6 months and started somewhere in November 2014

There are some things to think about before making an appeal.
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? : No
  • Do i have any evidence to show the staff if was false? : Nope
  • Have i waited long enough to be un-banned? : Yes
  • Have i been caught ban evading? Awnser : No
  • Have i appealed a ban before?  Awnser: No

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hi,

I have decided to lift your punishment because of the effort you have put into this appeal and the large amount of time you have served this punishment.

This will be your only chance. Get caught hacking again and you'll be banned for good. No second appeals. 

I suggest you also read the rules before re-joining the server.
